name: Tuna
source:
A Sepheric who come to assist [url=/c57073]Fumiki[/url] in order to stop [url=/c13978]Erediyu[/url] from achieving her plan. For some reasons, she cannot appear physically in Ukiyo. Therefore, she usually possesses [url=/c13980]Uiro[/url]'s body in order to communicate with Fumiki.

Little is known about her, but she seems to know a lot about Pandora.
